context.en: Liu Yu, founder of Liu Song, in an anonymous Qing-dynasty portrait.
context.zh: 刘宋开国君主刘裕的清代佚名画像。

context.en: Sima Yan, who launched the campaign, appears at left in this undated historical portrait album; Wu’s earlier founder Sun Quan appears at right.
context.zh: 发动伐吴战争的司马炎位于这幅年代未定的历史肖像对开左页，右页为吴国早先的创建者孙权。
